title: Snow Warg Pelts
description: Snow Warg Pelts — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Hughard the Arms Merchant

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Bring 10 Snow Warg Pelts from Algor's Terror-Dome to Hughard the Arms Merchant in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Hughard the Arms Merchant

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Pelt Season

Zone: Algor's Terror Dome (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Bring 10 Snow Warg Pelts from Algor's Terror-Dome to Hughard the Arms Merchant in Townston.

Offer:

The Commander tells me you're going to Algor's Terror-Dome. That place is one of the last wild frontiers! And you know what that means: untapped resources for all to reap!

The Snow Warg Pelts there are of a quality that is unrivaled anywhere in the Kingdom and I would love to get my hands on some. They can be found in the branches off of Upper Algor's Terror-Dome and if you have enough experience you can find them in the main areas of Lower Algor's Terror-Dome.

Gather them and you will be adequately compensated when you return to me, Hughard the Arms Merchant, here in Townston.

Turn-in:

These pelts are very high quality. I could probably use some more of them actually.

Objectives:

  • Snow Warg Pelt ×10

Level range: 13–25
